question: The Lambadi dance is a folk dance form of the ____________ tribe and originated in Andhra Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banjara**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Banjara** is the tribe associated with the Lambadi dance.
 
• The Lambadi dance is a traditional folk dance that originated in **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• This dance form is performed by the Banjara tribe, also known as the Lambadi or Gor Banjara.
